Recognition of Digital Watermarking

TIME has officially recognized Google’s SynthID as one of the Best Inventions of 2026. The technology addresses the growing challenge of identifying AI-generated media by embedding invisible, durable digital watermarks directly into content during creation.

Protecting Media Integrity

SynthID functions across images, video, audio, and text without compromising quality. Google reports that over 180 billion images and videos, along with 240,000 years of audio, have already been processed using this system. Recently, the company expanded the technology into synthetic biology with SynthID Bio.

Impact and Verification

Users can identify AI content via built-in tools in Google Search, Chrome, and Gemini. The SynthID Detector further allows for independent verification of files. These developments aim to provide necessary transparency in an evolving digital landscape. Readers can verify the full list of inventions at https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/models-and-research/google-deepmind/synthid-time-best-inventions/.
